transfer_test.scope: 1 MiB bulk write/read, deterministic data validation and periodic USB/keypad service; 6 MiB allocation, tail sentinel and both cache payloads

native_cases: idle clock uses the exact native Ark strike, right aligned in the title row
real legacy M0 APP: 192x64, four 16px rows, 10x16 glyph/12px advance and public font service agree pixel-for-pixel
alternate calculator digits and Ark Mono interface use native strikes; selected indicator font restored
native APP: wide Cyrillic/arrows, 19-column fixed cells, editor horizontal scroll/cursor, proportional row 12; exact pixels and DMA CRC
M61 default native 20x10 geometry, centred Ark strike and intact wide glyphs
BASIC and FOCAL PRINT AT: identical full native glyphs at pixel coordinates, independent Ark oracle
built-in editor and UTF-8 filename prompt: full wide glyphs, pixel-based horizontal scrolling and visible insertion cursor
Markdown and Explorer automatically select native WBMP sibling, all 320 columns preserved pixel-for-pixel
real WBMP.APP FILE_OPEN: Pico Down/Up page scrolling, bottom clamp and byte-exact return to first page
Bumblebee native 16x32 FMK, sprite at middle row with exact glyph pixels
actual Bumblebee autoexec: manual, optional BASIC geometry bootstrap, native trap handlers and live ROM-driven animation
hardware_cases: full 8 MiB PSRAM write-then-read/address pattern on real PIO/DMA; hardware CRC32 known vector
settled foreground waits for events while USB/status and keypad remain responsive
SD DMA+CRC16 read/write; warm PSRAM sector hits avoid physical reads; overwrite invalidates cached sectors
hardware RTC alarm IRQ wakes clock-gated sleep and delivers all due slots
app_cases: ELIZA: existing matching APP, native editor and exact HELLO reply, clean return
SHEET: existing matching APP, exact native empty grid, navigation and clean return

hardware.framebuffer_checks: USB snapshots, independent pixel oracles and DMA-source CRC; not optical panel readback

host_tests: ASan/UBSan shared buffers: bounds, fragmentation, eviction, pinning, SRAM fallback, I/O errors
Actual QPI PIO text simulator: all 1..32-byte packets, byte oracles, dummy cycles, FIFO, CE at 100/125 MHz
STM32 arenas/lifetimes: release orders, 6000-step gap oracle, APP/OOM and canaries
WBMP pointer/reader parity, bit-band path, malformed corpus and I/O errors

display.caveat: Transfer extrapolation only; no PSRAM-to-LCD pipeline implemented or benchmarked. Indirect PSRAM requires SRAM staging.

limitations: No new native APP memory-service ABI; malloc/pointers stay in SRAM
Block API extends the common manager; existing STM32 fixed arenas are preserved
QPI fallback is startup-only, before live data is published
Battery current and sleep without USB not measured: no batteries installed
